content: FFmpegKit (com.arthenica) is officially RETIRED (announced Jan 2025; binaries removed from Maven Central/CocoaPods/npm April 1, 2025). Pinned artifact com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-full-gpl:6.0-2 no longer resolves from Maven Central and its .so files are only 4 KB aligned, failing the 16 KB Play requirement. Community continuation io.github.maitrungduc1410:ffmpeg-kit-* (Maven Central, same com.arthenica.ffmpegkit Java API, 16 KB aligned) or self-rebuild with 16 KB linker flags are the viable paths.
